Home/About

Why we plan weddings the way we do

A studio of six, one wedding a weekend, and no templates.

Since 2014

A quieter way to plan

We take on one wedding per weekend, so the person who meets you at the first consultation is the person standing beside you on the day.

We have no preferred vendors and take no commissions. Every recommendation is made for your day, your guests and your budget.

I

Listen

Two long conversations before a single quote.

II

Design

A mood, a palette and a plan you can hold in your hand.

III

Hold

On the day, you do nothing but be there.

A beginner's guide to full planning

Everything you need to know before you start.

MMei Ling Tan12 March 2026

Good writing starts with a clear question. In this article we explore the idea in plain language, with examples you can use straight away.

The first thing to understand is that small decisions compound. Choosing carefully at the start saves far more time than it costs, and it makes every later step easier.

We have tested these approaches with real clients over several years. Some worked immediately; others needed adjusting. Here is what we learned.

Three things to remember

  • Start with the outcome you want.
  • Test small before you commit.
  • Write down what you learn.
